# HContextMenu

> Contextual commands with right-click, Shift+F10, and an explicit touch/keyboard trigger.

[Start with the Hearth UI agent index](../../../llms.txt). This describes repository source for version 0.7.0. Match documentation to your installed source/release.

## Identity

- Vue export: `HContextMenu` from `@hearth-ui/vue`.
- Custom element: `<hearth-context-menu>`.
- Constructor: `HearthContextMenuElement` from `@hearth-ui/elements`.
- Category: Controls.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/samishal1998/hearth-ui/blob/main/src/components/HContextMenu.vue).

## Choose and use it correctly

- Explicit action button is the touch/non-context-menu alternative. Supports right-click and Shift+F10 when focused descendants exist. Native popover is nonmodal and mobile-docked. Escape returns focus; menus use Arrow/Home/End and buffered typeahead.
- mobileBreakpoint sets the mobile viewport threshold in CSS pixels. Per-component props override the inherited --h-mobile-breakpoint value from HTheme; the fallback is 640px. Set 0 to keep desktop presentation. The breakpoint updates live across Vue and custom-element shadow roots.

## Public API

items, label, disabled, mobileBreakpoint

A `?` marks optional source props. Props with defaults may be omitted. Internal `formDisabled` and `control-sync` plumbing is excluded below; do not use it in application code.

```ts
type Props = {
    items: MenuAction[];
    label?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    mobileBreakpoint?: number;
};
```

### Defaults

```ts
{ items: () => [], label: "Context actions" }
```

### Events

select(id), update:open(boolean)

```ts
type Emits = {
    select: [
        id: string
    ];
    "update:open": [
        open: boolean
    ];
};
```

Vue-emitted custom-element events expose argument arrays in `event.detail`. Listen on the element. Native events such as `click` retain their normal payloads. The elements package provides framework-independent DOM event types.

### Slots

default

Vue uses `<template #slotName>`; custom elements use `<div slot="slotName">`. Web components do not support Vue scoped slots.

### CSS parts

base, panel

Use `hearth-context-menu::part(part-name)` for an exposed part or inherited `--h-*` tokens for shared styling. Native Vue components use the shared stylesheet and `h-*` classes.

## Supporting types

```ts
export interface MenuAction {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    icon?: IconValue;
    shortcut?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    danger?: boolean;
    separatorBefore?: boolean;
}

export type IconValue = string | IconDefinition;

export interface IconDefinition {
    paths: readonly string[];
    viewBox?: string;
    fill?: "none" | "currentColor";
    fillRule?: "nonzero" | "evenodd";
    strokeWidth?: number;
}
```

## Vue example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { HContextMenu, HSurface } from '@hearth-ui/vue';
import '@hearth-ui/vue/styles.css';
const actions=[{id:'edit',label:'Edit'},{id:'remove',label:'Remove',danger:true}];function act(id:string) { /* Perform the requested action. */ }
</script>

<template>
  <HContextMenu label="Resource commands" :items="actions" @select="act"><HSurface>Right-click this resource.</HSurface></HContextMenu>
</template>
```

## Web-component example

Provide a mount point. For field submission, use an owning native form; the auth page already contains its own form.

```html
<div id="example"></div>
```

This is bundler-based ESM. For raw HTML, load `dist/themes.css` with a link and import `registerElements` from `./dist/elements/index.js` instead. Initial array/object properties are assigned before connection to establish reset defaults.

```js
import { registerElements } from '@hearth-ui/elements';
import '@hearth-ui/elements/themes.css';
registerElements();

const mount = document.querySelector('#example');
const element = document.createElement('hearth-context-menu');
Object.assign(element, {
  "label": "Resource commands",
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "edit",
      "label": "Edit"
    },
    {
      "id": "remove",
      "label": "Remove",
      "danger": true
    }
  ]
});

element.innerHTML = "<hearth-surface>Right-click this resource.</hearth-surface>"; // Static example markup only; never inject untrusted HTML.

element.addEventListener('select', event => {
  const [value] = event.detail;
  // Update your application state using value.
});

mount.append(element);
```

- [HPopover](../popover/llms.txt): A nonmodal top-layer panel, anchored on desktop and docked at the bottom on mobile, with viewport-aware positioning and focus handling.
